---
title: "Model Diagnostics"
output: html_document
---

Examine dispersion, residuals, influence and conditional odds ratios. Accuracy and AUC refer to the fitting sample.

```{r setup}
root <- if (dir.exists("R")) "." else ".."
for (f in c("preprocessing", "modeling", "diagnostics")) source(file.path(root, "R", paste0(f, ".R")))
d <- prepare_flights(read.csv(file.path(root, "data/raw/flight_data_2024_sample_200k.csv")))$model
fit <- fit_models(d, backward = FALSE)
```

```{r diagnostics}
model_metrics(fit$final)
car::vif(fit$main)
car::vif(fit$final)
plot_diagnostics(fit$final)
anova(glm(is_delayed ~ 1, family = binomial(), data = fit$data), fit$final, test = "Chisq")
head(odds_ratios(fit$final))
```
